# --- u07.l01 ¿A cómo el kilo? (demonstratives). Also new here, row in core.tsv: naranja

column12: From Nahuatl. Each colonia has its tianguis day.
Este... is also the Mexican um...

column1: # --- u07.l02 ¿Me la puedo probar? (object pronouns, clothes)

column12: Singular in Spanish: la ropa es nueva.
Never chaqueta: it is vulgar slang in Mexico.
¿Me lo puedo probar?: Can I try it on?
Feminine la, plural los and las: la compro, los quiero.

column1: # --- u07.l03 ¿Me lo deja más barato? (comparatives, money)

column12: ¿Me lo deja en cien?: Will you let me have it for a hundred?

column1: # --- supporting (no lesson introduces these; usable from Unit 7 on)

column12: Tan caro como: as expensive as. (Yo) como also means I eat.
Tan barato como: as cheap as.
What market vendors and their regulars call each other.
The fruit of the nopal. Tuna the fish is atún.
